response.status: int: 0 routed, 1 endpoint threw, 2 endpoint not found

envelope.jsonPolicy: camelCase property names; nulls omitted on write; numbers may arrive as JSON strings; property matching is case-insensitive on read

T0.title: Session floor
T0.rule: No client of any shape works without these. They are transport lifecycle, not product features: an SDK that omits one is broken rather than incomplete.

T1.title: 1:1 chat MVP
T1.rule: The smallest set that ships a two-person chat app a customer would actually launch: send, receive, backfill, read state, profiles, attachments, offline push. Cutting any one of these leaves a hole the tenant must fill with raw invoke() on day one.

T2.title: Social graph and groups
T2.rule: What turns a 1:1 chat into a messenger: contacts, blocking, group create/join/manage, presence, and the message operations users expect once more than two people can see a message.

T3.title: Competitive parity
T3.rule: Not needed to ship, needed to win. These are the rows a buyer ticks off against 融云 / 环信 / 网易云信 feature matrices. A tenant can live without each one individually; a buyer comparing tables cannot.

T4.title: Specialist verticals
T4.rule: Load-bearing for a minority of tenants and dead weight for the rest: calls, service desk, end-to-end encryption, live chat rooms, AI streaming, scheduling, folders. Correctly typed when a customer asks; never a reason to delay T0–T3.

App-store review treats user blocking as mandatory for any app with user-generated content.

ADR-003. Call once after every connect, never on a timer: requests are raised by a person looking at a support ticket. Each row carries a freshly signed upload target — the one issued when the request was raised may already have expired. 每次连接后调一次，不要轮询。
The agent's canned-reply list. Its request body is optional, which is what the generator's parameter regex could not read until 2026-08-27.
LLM reply suggestions for an agent; returns 1203 when no provider is configured. Tiered on 2026-08-27 with desk.rate and desk.canned.
The customer rates a finished desk session. Tiered on 2026-08-27: it shipped untiered, which stopped the generator and froze the inventory.
Agent-console surface. The customer side of a desk session arrives as ordinary messages.
Drives the app badge; a chat app cannot ship a correct badge without it.
Pin, mute, draft and tags in one call.
Cold-start correctness hinges on this call's convSeqs. See sdk/CONTRACT.md §5.
Untyped in all five SDKs today. Without it a long-lived session dies at token expiry instead of renewing in place.

ADR-003. Answer every request, including a refusal: silence is indistinguishable from a device that never received the frame, and the two send a support engineer in opposite directions. Report `volatile` from the store's identity, never from a flag the store declares. 拒绝也要答复；volatile 由 SDK 判断而不是由存储自称。
Both the gap-repair primitive and a public method: tenants with their own store call it directly.

The other half of what friend.block is here for: app-store review requires both a way to block an abusive user and a way to report objectionable content. An SDK that has completed T2 without this still cannot pass review, which is the same argument that put blocking in T2.
E2EE key directory. The SDK stores and transports keys; it performs no cryptography.
